visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and beige trousers, stands in a brightly lit, modern white kitchen. He is focused on cutting a small yellow fruit or vegetable on a white countertop. To his right, a knife block and paper towel roll are visible. He stops and looks around cautiously. A woman wearing glasses and a dark hoodie silently appears behind him, looking over his shoulder. They lock eyes in a medium close-up shot. (2) The man stands before a white refrigerator, holding a large carton of milk. He takes a long drink directly from the carton. As he tilts his head back, the woman is revealed standing directly behind him with her arms crossed and a stern expression. He pulls the carton away, looking surprised and guilty. (3) The man enters a hallway or living room area, now wearing a black cardigan over his t-shirt. He moves with a slightly suspicious, sneaking posture. To the left, a shelf is filled with various colorful figurines and toys. He looks up and spots the woman standing by a wall, watching him silently with the same crossed-arm pose. He offers a wide, awkward smile. (4) The screen cuts to black with white text centered in the frame.

The repetitive structure and suspenseful BGM create a mock-horror atmosphere for comedic effect.
